old_AS_rules: G1: nouns denote classes. Postposed daiin selects a definite discourse instance of the current nominal term. Applying it again to the same reference is idempotent; this is an explicit hypothesis motivated before freeze by9cached adjacent pairs, not a new sense or numeral.

G2: pchaiin heads an attributed medical-effect record: material/location, intervention, person/site, indication, authority. The final disease and authority are typed argument fields. This is a paid serial record construction, not a recovered sentence grammar.

G3: cfhy relates the current study material to the following location phrase; doroiin ypchol are appositional location descriptions. sy scopes the following definite nominal head as their possessor. No source clause is assigned to a single token.
G4: ol daiin introduces container B. qokchy binds the retained study material W in B. The material slot survives the head/location qualifier; it does not switch to H by nearest-noun lookup.
G5: dar daiin introduces wearer/patient P. chor places current container B at the following body-site choice. Bare body-site classes inherit P only within this placement frame.

G6: oky selects a disjunctive choice between body-site terms. y is a possessive reference operator, using the current P and its following nominal term/reference; ARM and FEVER belong to/affect that same P. Context must supply P; no new binder is invented in unknown intervals.

G7: the complete placement is followed by a possessed disease as indication, then the authority. The reported medical-benefit relation is supplied by pchaiin, not inferred from the name or a free ending.

G8: only observed ycholdchy receives the explicit whole-value equivalent of y choldchy. ctheen and ctheeb are distinct observed whole aliases for the uncertain authority hypothesis. No general y-prefix, suffix, proper-name phonetics or stem rule is exported.

G9: raw line ends do not close constructions. ZL/IT paragraph4-6 is the proposed scope; RF uses the same physical comparison window with absent paragraph flags retained. No other paragraph scope is silently repaired.

new_rules: E1: pchedar activates ONE new case-record frame. Following qodary daiiin introduces present sufferer P2: qodary supplies class SUFFERER and daiiin selects this case instance. Daiiin is an independently paid whole, not an alias of daiin or a count. No pchaiin/G2 frame is activated.

E2: This new frame retains P2 through its typed record fields until ysheey. Unchanged y applies to P2 and its immediately following EAR_CANAL class; bare dar predicates WEARER_PATIENT of P2 in recipient/followup/progress fields. Class denotation and old G1 remain; this new contextual instantiation is paid, not supplied by unknown text.

E3: Typed record operators saraiir/pchdar/review-whole/toeedy/pchedy/tchedy/ysheey introduce examination/care/review/followup/progress/storage/closure subrecords. They list ordered typed fields; adjacent class/property fields form postmodified nominal cells. Written line ends do not close these records; scope follows actual record operators. This is a new paid paratactic record grammar, not a parser derived from the structural baseline.

E4: Within the central material cell the ordered LEAVES JUICE pair predicates juice J2 derived from leaves L2. Following EXPRESSION names preparation X2 of J2. This part-first product-second derivation schema is new and paid; it exports no OFCH or CHEO component meaning.

E5: ACTING_MATERIAL_MARKER assigns the immediately prior product J2 as agent of the next event noun KILLING. KILLING takes the immediately following class WORMLIKE_CREATURES as affected population W2. Following AT EAR supplies location E2 for W2. This nominal event/agent/affected/location argument construction is explicit new syntax; OFCHY material_class and denotation remain unchanged.

E6: The two EFFECTIVE occurrences both modify K2; repetition intensifies the same property, rather than names a second killing or a second population. This is a paid duplicate-property rule, distinct from old G1 duplicate daiin idempotence.

E7: Ear E2 in this P2 case is a body site of P2 and E2c is its canal. Canal/ear part relation and same case owner are an explicit new anatomical/context binding. It does not make W2 the same population as AS W1 or make P2=P1, and no leaf plant identity or source authority is inferred.

E8: New operators are finite scoped argument constructions: REGARDING scopes the following nominal cell; FOR selects the following recipient class; AND coordinates adjacent cells; CONTINUE operates on current TREATMENT until the following termination condition; postfix AVOID negates the immediately preceding pressure cell; RETAIN takes BALANCE with BEFORE IRRITATION; AFTER takes CASE_INTERVAL and REPEAT refers to the current TREATMENT. These rules are independently paid, not q-imperatives or y-prefix rules.

E9: In STORAGE_RECORD VESSEL and LIQUID are contents fields; KEEP with COVERED requests a covered vessel. DISCARD acts on immediately preceding LIQUID conditioned by IF_TAINTED. REEXAMINE refers to the current case. M2 liquid is an unbound separate material, not silently identified as J2. No arbitrary narrative clause is hidden in any single word.

E10: ZL paragraph scope is the predeclared entire f26v1–9. IT has separate1–2,3–4,5–6,7–9paragraphs: these are retained native boundaries, not rewritten as one paragraph. Exact alternate wholes can retain dictionary values but the full argument graph is NOT asserted for them; differing/merged/uncertain forms remain unknown. RF samephysical window has absent flags.

reading: One ear-associated medical case with examination, care and followup fields. Its central C0 event is expressed leaf juice J2 killing a distinct wormlike population W2 at an ear E2. Surrounding medical context is an unsupported author construction; this is not an exact Lonitzer copy.

case_patient.source_status: not named in the source; invented clinical context

assumptions: 75 new complete-word values, including many frequent broadly distributed wholes, are source-conditioned C0 guesses; all78 distinct ZL forms are assigned, not independently identified.
Ten new paid syntax/scope rules; no old AS rule/value/type is modified, and no global ofch, q, y, dy, numeral, degree or medical dictionary is imported.

P2 is an invented clinical case participant absent from the source ear-worm sentence; P2 owner/case persistence, P2 EAR_CANAL/EAR part binding and every surrounding symptom/treatment/storage/followup relation are unsupported added clinical context.

The central six duties are deliberately fitted with new whole-values: leaves, juice derivation, acting-material marker, killing-event noun, affectedW2 and ear association. This is source-fit authorship, not evidence for those values.
The leafjuice expression step is an added preparation assumption: sucus foliorum names the product but does not explicitly prescribe extraction method.

The doubled effectiveness claim, discomfort/swelling/blockage/pain/congestion, dose, treatment, pressure/rest/balance, storage/disposal and unfavorable-response instructions are not in the compared source clause.

No named patient, administration, dose, medical benefit or Dioscorides authority is transferred from source into the central claimed killing relation. Surrounding clinical additions remain separate and unsupported.

KILLING assigned to opchedy respects its nominal/content-field prior as an event noun, but its patient/agent argument grammar remains a new guess. Common ar=EAR has many outside-H occurrences whose accounts are unresolved.

OFCHY conservatively nominal/content-like prior supports neither creature identity nor drug identity. New derivational family meanings are not exported; ofchdy=FOREIGN_MATTER is an independent whole-value and no claim of creature-state composition.

Storage LIQUID M2 is not tied to J2; incidental unsupported material classes and field lists leave relations deliberately underconstrained. This cost may prevent the complete word rendering from being a complete semantic account.
AS suspension-agreement debt,107outside unresolved rows, singleton authority/indication/body-site meanings and nominal-role pressure remain exactly as before. This account does not repair AS.
IT/RF alternate forms are not new aliases and their paragraph/window interpretations are partial; concordance does not give independent confirmation.
grammar_and_frequency_constraints: Preauthor compact profile read before preference. New record-operator assignments are locally compatible with strong first-position profiles for pchedar/pchedy/tchedy/ysheey, yet positions do not translate them.
